title: Site Operations Director, Concrete Pipe Production
text:
**Site Operations Director, Concrete Pipe Production**
======================================================

**Pay:** $210,000 (DOE)

**Why join Thompson Pipe Group – Los Angeles?**
-----------------------------------------------

Family-founded. Engineer-led. Builder-trusted. From Rialto, CA, we deliver precast concrete solutions that keep communities moving. Step into a role where your operational rigor sets the pace for safety, quality, delivery, and cost.

**Is this you?**
----------------

* Do you energize large teams and develop leaders who deliver results?
* Do you turn KPIs into action—closing gaps in productivity, quality, and cost?
* Do you love orchestrating manufacturing, distribution, maintenance, QA, and safety into one cohesive operation?
* Do you navigate C-suite conversations as comfortably as you coach front-line supervisors?

**What you’ll do**
------------------

* Direct end-to-end TPG–Los Angeles operations to enhance efficiency and reliability.
* Design and deploy policies, procedures, and operating mechanisms that scale.
* Set targets, collect and analyze metrics, and present insights and plans to stakeholders.
* Lead budget creation and ownership of P&L results; manage costs and drive data-based decisions.
* Build capability: clear goals, continuous feedback, and development plans for leaders and teams.
* Ensure compliance with regulations and strengthen plant safety, processes, and training.
* Partner closely with EHS, HR, Maintenance, Logistics, and other support functions.
* Research the market and identify growth opportunities to advance the company’s objectives and reputation.

**What you bring**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree.
* 3+ years of manufacturing operations management, spanning people, products, resources, budgets, change, and quality.
* Industrial manufacturing experience; construction/building materials preferred.
* Commercial mindset with experience engaging all levels up to C-level.
* Proven ability to structure large operations and delegate effectively through leaders.
* Demonstrated ownership of product quality and a proactive approach to issue prevention and resolution.
* Fluency in operations, sales, and project management.
* Exceptional communication; strong organization and multi-initiative execution discipline.
* Financial leadership (budgets, P&L, cost control) with analytical decision-making.
* MS Office, MS Project, Visio, or equivalent proficiency.

**Benefits and development**
----------------------------

* Medical, Vision and Dental, Life Benefits
* Life & Supplement Life
* Company Matched 401K retirement plan
* Vacation & Sick Leave
* Training and Development
* Career Opportunity!
* $1,000.00 Referral Bonus

**Where you’ll work**
---------------------

3009 N Laurel Avenue, Rialto, CA 92377

Not a warehouse position—this is hands-on precast concrete pipe manufacturing.

**Notes**
---------

* This description outlines the role’s general scope and may evolve as business needs change.
* Responsibilities may be reassigned to meet operational requirements.

**Compliance**
--------------

Must pass Pre-employment Physical and drug test.

* Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions upon request.

* Thompson pipe group is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer that welcomes all qualified applicants. Applicants will receive fair and impartial consideration without regard to race, sex, color, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic data, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion or another legally protected status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

* Drug-free workplace.

EOE/AA – M/F/Vet/Disability
